In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the rogue [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Fives/Legends|Fives]] '''escaped''' from [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]] with the [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] [[AZI-345211896246498721347/Legends|AZI-3]], only to return to the [[City/Legends|city]] once the pursuant [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces were off his tail.
